subject: Subprocessor delegation: approval matrix request & DPA evidence for EdgeCloud change
messages:
From: Elena Mendez <elena@edgecloud.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: EdgeCloud Legal <legal@edgecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: new subcontractor for log processing (DataHabit) / DPA attached

Hi Priyom,

Per Section 6 of our MSA, I wanted to give formal notice that EdgeCloud intends to engage DataHabit (AI log processing) to perform log parsing and ephemeral enrichment on a subset of customer telemetry tied to the EdgeCloud Log Ingest product. The work is scoped to: aggregated log normalization, IP anonymization, and short-lived entity enrichment.

We have attached the subprocessor notice and the DataHabit DPA (EdgeCloud-Subproc-Notice_20261109.pdf). DataHabit has indicated they will not persist raw PII beyond 72 hours and will process data under our DPA obligations. Please let us know if Redwood requires additional evidence (SOC 2/ISO) or a specific flow-down amendment to the Order Form or Exhibit A.

If you prefer, I can send a DocuSign envelope for a one-time consent addendum; otherwise we can proceed under the existing DPA. ETA for go-live: 2026-12-06 (pilot).

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Mendez
Senior Contracts Manager, EdgeCloud Inc.
Attachments: EdgeCloud-Subproc-Notice_20261109.pdf

Priyom / Dev — quick notes after a first pass:

- Scope question: the vendor notice is a bit vague about which customer tenants will be in scope for the pilot. We should ask EdgeCloud to confirm (all customers vs. opt-in customers). If it’s "all" we will need explicit Exhibit A amendment.
- Data access: confirm whether DataHabit will receive any unredacted customer identifiers (emails, account ids). The DPA attachment says "anonymize" but lacks the technical detail we typically look for.
- Evidence checklist: request (1) SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months), (2) vulnerability/pen test summary, (3) list of sub-subprocessors for DataHabit, (4) encryption-at-rest details.

I attached a draft approval matrix that has the routing steps we use for subprocessor consent: Legal -> Security -> Procurement -> Account / CS. I propose we add a minor Order Form redline that references the limited-scope pilot (date window) to keep the production footprint constrained.

Can Dev confirm whether a redline to Exhibit A would be limited to the definition of "subprocessors" (recommended) or also include an audit-rights clause change?

Attachments: draft-approval-matrix_20261109.xlsx

-Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai

Thanks — quick legal/procurement take and proposed next-actions (I've included inline answers to Monica's bullets):

- Tenant scope: ask EdgeCloud to limit the pilot to a specific set of accounts (we should list the HubSpot deal ids if they plan to include any Redwood-managed customer data). If EdgeCloud insists on broader access, require an Exhibit A amendment.
- Data access: the DPA language is borderline on "anonymize". I'll propose a narrow redline to the Order Form Exhibit A: add "subprocessor may not retain raw customer identifiers beyond 72 hours and shall not process account-level PII without explicit customer opt-in." See attached proposed redline: orderform-exhibitA-proposed-redline_20261110.docx.
- Evidence: Naomi, if you can validate SOC2 Type II + pen test summary, we can move to consent. If DataHabit can't produce SOC2, require a compensating control (continuous monitoring + read-only audit access for Redwood).

Operational gating: my recommended approval matrix and timeline:
1) Security evidence received/validated — 2 business days after request (Naomi)
2) Legal redline agreed (me) — 1 business day after evidence confirmed
3) Procurement signs off and DocuSign addendum executed — 1 business day after redline acceptance
4) Pilot enablement — scheduled one business day after DocuSign signature

I will prepare the DocuSign addendum using our standard subprocessor consent template and include the Exhibit A redline. Priyom — can you confirm which customer tenants (if any) will be in scope so I can populate the addendum? Once finalized I will circulate the DocuSign link for signatures.

Next steps (owners):
- Naomi to validate security artifacts (owner: naomi_feldman)
- Priyom to confirm tenant list / customer opt-in (owner: priyom_das)
- Dev to finalize redline + DocuSign envelope (owner: dev_patel)
- Monica to update approval matrix and record procurement gate in the project tracker (owner: monica_patel)

Attachments: orderform-exhibitA-proposed-redline_20261110.docx

Best,
